I attached a short preliminary capacity plan we sketched (prelim-capacity-plan.pdf) and a sample MLOps diagram (sample-mlops-diagram.png) to help frame the discussion.

- Wed Jun 10, 09:30–11:00 PT (90m)

Thanks,
